packageRules.description: One weekly window for every update. The preset schedules dependencies, devDependencies and the package manager separately, and its non-major group puts dependencies and devDependencies in one branch; together with the two-hour Wednesday window this file used to set, not one pull request opened between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-25.

Kodiak merges every pull request whose checks pass — require_automerge_label is false in mheob/.github's .github/.kodiak.toml — so a major would land unreviewed. It never merges a draft, and CI still runs on one: marking the pull request ready for review is the decision to merge.
packages/api-client pins TypeScript 6 for its generator, which crashes on 7 (CLAUDE.md). CI never runs the generator, so a bump would pass every check and break the next regeneration.

Held at the versions #91 pinned. router-core 1.171.30 changed interpolatePath's signature in a patch release and @storybook/tanstack-react 10.6.0 still calls the old form, so every story fails. Fixed by storybookjs/storybook#36333, in no release as of 2026-09-25. Remove this rule once Renovate proposes a @storybook/tanstack-react release that carries it, and move the four packages together.
